definitions.explanation: Describes something that is old and deteriorated, falling apart or in poor condition.
Describes something breaking apart or crumbling into pieces.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ぼろぼろ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: These shoes have become worn out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぼろぼろ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{危|あぶ}ない→危ない：00768_abunai⟧。
examples.english: The old house is falling apart and dangerous.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぼろぼろ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: The dictionary I've been using for years is getting worn out.

examples.japanese: ⟦クッキー→クッキー：10798_kukkii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぼろぼろ⟦{崩|くず}れた→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧。
⟦{乾|かわ}いた→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぼろぼろ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: Dry soil crumbled and fell off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ペンキ→ペンキ：00342_penki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧、ぼろぼろ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{剥|は}がれて→剥がれる：04363_hagareru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: The paint on the wall got old and started peeling off in flakes.

notes:
ぼろぼろ is a mimetic word (⟦{擬態語|ぎたいご}→擬態語：22468_gitaigo⟧) describing things that are worn out, falling apart, or crumbling.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ぼろぼろ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become worn out/tattered
- ぼろぼろの〜: worn-out, tattered (noun modifier)
- ぼろぼろ⟦{崩|くず}れる→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧: to crumble apart

USAGE:
- ぼろぼろ⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧: to cry one's eyes out (tears falling like drops)
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぼろぼろ: physically exhausted/broken down
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぼろぼろ: emotionally shattered
Functions as a na-adjective modifier (ぼろぼろな/ぼろぼろの) or adverbially (ぼろぼろ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧). Very common in everyday speech.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ぼろい→ぼろい：noentry⟧: shabby, worn out (i-adjective)
- ⟦がたがた→がたがた：05274_gatagata⟧: rattling, shaky (more about instability than deterioration)
